description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

Tem a função de produzir materiais diários com a equipe operacional para exibição nas emissoras as quais a instituição aluga o espaço. O Editor de Mídia Audiovisual é responsável por editar, finalizar e adequar conteúdos em vídeo e áudio, garantindo qualidade técnica e estética conforme os padrões da emissora. Atua diretamente na montagem de programas, chamadas, reportagens, vinhetas, materiais institucionais e conteúdos para múltiplas plataformas (TV, internet e redes sociais).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar a edição de vídeo e áudio de programas, reportagens, matérias jornalísticas, chamadas e institucionais.
  • Fazer cortes, inserções, trilhas, legendas, correções de cor, ajustes de som e montagem final conforme roteiro e orientação da produção/direção.
  • Preparar e organizar o material bruto, mantendo arquivos e backups de forma estruturada.
  • Adequar formatos de entrega conforme as especificações técnicas (resoluções, codecs, padrões de TV e plataformas digitais).
  • Trabalhar em sintonia com as equipes de produção, cinegrafia, arte e operação técnica para garantir fluidez e coerência narrativa.
  • Operar softwares de edição não linear (Adobe Premiere).
  • Fazer ajustes de áudio básico (equalização, volume, limpeza de ruídos) e inserção de trilhas ou locuções.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de prazos, qualidade técnica e padrão estético da emissora.
  • Participar do processo de finalização e exportação dos materiais para exibição e arquivamento.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo; curso técnico ou graduação em Produção Audiovisual, Rádio e TV, Cinema, Multimídia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em edição de vídeo e áudio em ambiente profissional (TV, produtora, agência ou estúdio).
  • Domínio de softwares de edição (especificamente Premiere) e conhecimentos de After Effects ou ferramentas de motion serão diferenciais.
  • Boa percepção visual e senso estético, domínio de ritmo e narrativa audiovisual.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob prazos curtos e em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Organização de arquivos, disciplina de backups e controle de versões de projetos.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em finalização para TV aberta e plataformas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em color grading e design de som.
  • Noções de compressão, exportação e entrega para diversos formatos (broadcast, streaming, redes sociais).

description:
Senior Customer Success Analyst (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo)

Join to apply for the Senior Customer Success Analyst (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo) role at Equinix .

Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Equinix is a global digital infrastructure company, operating more than 260 data centers worldwide. Digital leaders use Equinix’s reliable platform to connect and interconnect core infrastructure at the speed of software. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, accelerate the launch of digital services, deliver world‑class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting sustainability goals.

As a Senior Customer Success Analyst, you will strategically drive three core pillars to the business:

  • Relationship with Field Sales customers: provide direct support to strategic, large accounts, ensuring an excellent experience from first contact.
  • Support to sales with a focus on upselling: work side‑by‑side with the commercial team, identifying expansion opportunities and proposing solutions that align with customer needs.
  • Retention and customer loyalty: lead an effective onboarding and maintain continuous follow‑up, analyzing metrics, controlling churn and proactively preventing and resolving issues to ensure customer satisfaction and continued engagement.

Integration of Clients

Use judgment to tailor the best client interaction approach, considering their needs and the scope of the project. Follow the 3‑phase methodology:

  • Phase 1 – Pre‑integration: Perform preparatory activities with all clients.
  • Phase 2 – Initial meeting: Schedule, facilitate and conduct initial integration meetings.
  • Phase 3 – Continuous follow‑up: Establish a regular cadence of contact to monitor client evolution.

You may lead integrations across regions in partnership with other Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Translate internal processes clearly, align expectations and positively influence clients and stakeholders.

Relationship and Personalization

Interact with cross‑functional teams, collect detailed client information to personalize experiences and understand strategic direction. After onboarding, follow up on actions and tasks linked to client goals. Identify trends and ask strategic questions to deepen business understanding.

Adoption and Customer Success Management

Develop, maintain and monitor Customer Success Plans across scopes. Promote product and process adoption based on usage trends. Share product knowledge to empower clients. Collect and manage feedback, proposing continuous improvements based on client insights.

Strategic Collaboration

Collaborate with account teams in pre‑sales discussions, acting as a customer advocate. Ensure smooth transitions across internal areas. Lead special projects with cross‑functional teams, including global accounts. Implement best practices and maintain proactive client contact.

Issue and Escalation Management

Assess and prioritize issues and escalations, ensuring visibility and proper resolution. Work with stakeholders to enforce policies and procedures, communicating resolutions and improvement plans with clarity and empathy.

Account Retention

Partner with sales and management for account oversight. Support contractual obligations, proactively identify churn risks and contribute to retention strategies. Conduct regular operational reviews and manage follow‑up projects.

Main Requirements

  • Completed higher education.
  • Advanced English (interview in English).
  • Prior experience in Customer Success, Post‑sales, Technical Support or Consulting.
  • Experience handling a diverse, extensive B2B client portfolio.
  • Knowledge of customer success metrics (NPS, churn, CSAT, health score).
  • Familiarity with CRM tools and CS platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Previous direct collaboration with the sales team.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in technology companies (SaaS, Cloud, Infrastructure or Data Center).

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

Acreditamos que um ambiente de excelência, aprendizado rápido, foco obsessivo no cliente junto com muita colaboração e diversão permite a todos alcançar o seu potencial pleno e contribuir com nossa missão.

O desafio é estruturar controles e processos que sustentem nosso crescimento e tragam cada vez mais eficiência e precisão às nossas operações.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.

Your profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: SUERVISOR DE USINA (207)
description:
A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.
Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais.

Descrição

  • Supervisionar a execução das manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretiva em cumprimento ao cronograma de manutenção;
  • Elaborar escala de trabalho para execução das manutenções programadas e emergenciais;
  • Elaborar de instrução de trabalho para inspeção em equipamentos e circuitos elétricos de baixa e média tensão;
  • Suporte e interface com a equipe de planejamento para o alinhamento do cronograma de manutenções e distribuir as atividades entre a equipe;
  • Suporte ao engenheiro eletricista da área;
  • Emissão de relatórios e registro de ocorrências;
  • Analisar relatórios de performance da planta;
  • Realizar elaboração de orçamentos de manutenção e garantir a conformidade;
  • Monitorar o inventário de materiais e equipamentos;
  • Participar na coordenação de projetos (ampliações e reformas);
  • Garantir o cumprimento do programa de 5S;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança e saúde ocupacional, através de ações preventivas e corretivas junto à equipe de trabalho;
  • Otimizar processos com foco no atendimento ao cliente.

Requisitos

  • Formação Técnica em Eletrotécnica ou afins;
  • Experiência com rotinas de Operação e Manutenção de Usinas Solares;
  • Conhecimento das práticas e regulamentos de saúde e segurança
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares de manutenção;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office;

Benefícios

  • Gympass
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed
  • Plano Odontológico
  • PLR- (Participação nos lucros e resultados, caso o resultado seja atingido)
  • Seguro de Vida

VEM SER NATURAL DA TERRA! Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa.

title: ENCARREGADO 1
description:
Supervisor de Produção I Duque de Caxias - Seara

Duque de Caxias, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

  • Zelar pela correta utilização do uniforme e EPIs, asseio pessoal, materiais e produtos, conforme padronização de acordo com procedimento, orientação do superior hierárquico e normas de segurança;
  • Acompanhar o andamento das atividades diárias verificando o RAD (relatório de atividade de diária), acompanhando a aplicação das técnicas de limpeza e higienização conforme procedimento;
  • Organizar a distribuição da equipe de trabalho, liderando equipes, definindo as tarefas a serem executadas e alocando nos setores;
  • Conferir e orientar os funcionários no correto preenchimento de Relatórios, durante as rondas no prédio e ao final do plantão;
  • Realizar checklist nos novos colaboradores conforme rotina estabelecida, esclarecendo sobre as normas disciplinares, instruções de trabalho, normas de segurança, visitação dos setores, visando adequada ambientação;
  • Conferir o abastecimento do material e distribuição quando necessário, checar o DML (depósito de material de limpeza) e carrinho funcional, para que o colaborador execute suas funções diárias;
  • Realizar o Checklist de limpeza em formulários específicos avaliando o resultado da limpeza/higienização, orientando a equipe quando detectada falha, assegurando o protocolo e padronização estabelecidos;
  • Monitorar a conduta disciplinar da equipe, orientando e corrigindo comportamentos inadequados, aplicando as punições cabíveis conforme código de conduta;
  • Atentar para a aplicação prática dos conhecimentos adquiridos nos treinamentos realizados no contrato, para multiplicação das práticas adequadas;
  • Garantir a correta utilização e distribuição do uniforme e EPIs, e orientar quanto ao adequado asseio pessoal dos auxiliares de limpeza, seguindo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos;
  • Preencher controle de EPI, registrando o equipamento disponibilizado ao colaborador, colhendo assinatura, conforme orientação a normas de segurança;
  • Verificar etiquetas dos produtos no estoque e diluídos, fazendo conferência de prazos de validade, conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque no contrato, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação;
  • Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos;
  • Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto;
  • Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas;
  • Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato;
  • Fazer a passagem de plantão em conjunto com a liderança do outro plantão, fazendo a ronda nos setores, sinalizando as ocorrências, registrando as informações, visando adequada continuidade das atividades no contrato;
  • Fazer ronda nos setores orientando os auxiliares na execução das tarefas, na correta aplicação da técnica de limpeza, corrigindo postura, delegando atribuições e acompanhando a execução, a fim de avaliar o resultado conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Encaminhar e acompanhar o funcionário, no caso de Acidente de Trabalho ou algum tipo de ocorrência médica, informando ao superior hierárquico, segurança do trabalho e os familiares sobre ocorrido;
  • Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados;
  • Comparecer em audiência como prepostos, representando a empresa, em processos judiciais e administrativos, caso haja requisição do departamento jurídico;
  • Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Contrato: CLT

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Manager role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth‑stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e‑commerce marketplace, direct‑to‑consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high‑impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About The Role

We are looking for a highly innovative, data‑driven Email Marketing Manager, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest growing e‑commerce and digital brands. You will join a team of email, SMS and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, partner with internal cross‑functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross‑functional team to build creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Spain, Mexico, Portugal, and Brazil.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands‑on retention experience.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI, etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You’re used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You’ve had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life

  • Serve as the primary retention lead for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a bi‑weekly basis, you will lead meetings with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email, SMS, loyalty and subscription programs.
  • Project manage and delegate campaign briefs to your team, consisting of both retention specialists and designers.
  • Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client to ensure campaign quality and accuracy.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Growth, Digital, and Marketplaces teams to develop cohesive campaigns that drive client growth.

Working at Darkroom

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We believe the best ideas come from empowered teams: those who consistently collaborate with intention to design solutions, spark ideas, and drive impact. Our people are at the heart of our success.

Please submit your CV in English.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

The People Operations Generalist role at TKWW will provide some operational support to People BPs, but with a renewed focus on process standardization, HR systems management, and data ownership. People Operations is responsible for setting the global standards, processes, and policies for all employee lifecycle changes, and the Generalist will play a key role in ensuring these processes are executed flawlessly across all regions . The People Operations Generalist will manage administrative tasks related to the employee lifecycle (such as onboarding, offboarding, promotions, merit adjustments, etc.), but with an increased emphasis on process alignment, systems management, and data integrity. As the "guardians of the data," People Operations is accountable for the accuracy and reliability of employee information, and you will help maintain this high standard by ensuring that all data and lifecycle changes are recorded and updated correctly.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage and execute the end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, promotions, merit adjustments, and employee transfers. Ensure all changes are documented accurately in HR systems, in employee files, in documented employee memos, and aligned with company policies and local labor laws.
  • HR Systems Management & Data Integrity: Oversee and maintain employee data within the HR systems (e.g., HRIS, ATS, in collaboration with payroll). As a key member of the People Ops team, you will ensure that all employee lifecycle changes are accurately tracked and aligned with standard operating procedures. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity of employee data, making sure it is up-to-date and reflects changes accurately across systems.
  • Process Standardization & Execution: Follow and execute standardized People Operations processes for all employee lifecycle events, ensuring compliance with global policies and local regulations. Support the continuous improvement of these processes to increase efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Collaboration with Total Rewards: Support the People Operations team in areas related to Total Rewards, including compensation and benefits. You may assist with administering benefits programs, ensuring accuracy in pay and benefit-related changes, and liaising with external vendors or partners for benefits enrollment and compensation adjustments.
  • Ad Hoc People Operations Support: Provide general support to the broader People Operations function on various initiatives, including but not limited to compliance projects, mandatory compliance training, and other HR programs.
  • Regional & Global Partnership:
    • Work closely with global People Ops teams to ensure processes and initiatives are aligned across regions. In the absence of a local HRBP or People Ops team, you will be relied upon to handle a broad range of employee needs and act as a key resource for your region.
    • You will have the opportunity to partner with broader teams to provide additional support in areas such as Total Rewards (compensation and benefits), new hire orientation .
    • You may be asked to provide local support for answering employee inquiries, providing guidance on company policies, benefits or other essential information, and acting as a liaison between employees and the global People teams.

SUCCESSFUL PEOPLE OPERATIONS GENERALIST CANDIDATES HAVE:

  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in an HR Generalist, or People Operations role, with strong experience supporting employee lifecycle management processes (onboarding, offboarding, promotions, etc.), HR systems management, and compliance.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • HR Systems & Data Management: Familiarity with HRIS systems and experience with data entry, system management, and reporting. Strong attention to detail and a passion for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of employee data.
  • Process-Oriented Mindset: Experience in implementing and executing standardized HR processes, with a focus on streamlining workflows and maintaining compliance with global and local policies.
  • Regional Expertise (where applicable): Experience working in specific geographic regions with an understanding of local labor laws and HR practices. In regions where you are the sole People Ops representative, the ability to take ownership of various HR functions, including performance management and employee relations, will be critical.
  • Total Rewards Knowledge: A basic understanding of compensation, benefits, and rewards programs is a plus, particularly in how these programs impact the employee lifecycle.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise between employees, People BPs, and other key stakeholders. Comfortable working across cultures and with diverse teams.
  • Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. You should be proactive, adaptable, and able to problem-solve as challenges arise.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail, especially when handling employee data, documentation, and system updates.
  • Educational Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. HR certifications (e.g., SHRM-CP, PHR) are a plus.

WORK MODEL: This role is fully remote and not tied to any specific office location. While there are no regular in-office requirements, we encourage our remote team members to gather intentionally for key company and team events to stay connected and engaged.

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe you are more than a resume and invite you to go for it, take the leap of faith, and apply for this job if it sparks your passion to join TKWW and make a difference!

WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:

We believe in a wide range of holistic offerings to support our employees so that they can live our values day in and day out. From mental wellbeing, physical health and financial planning, to engaging perks and discounts, we are in the business of celebrating and supporting the Moments that Matter both in and out of the “office”. We offer flexible vacation, generous parental leave and prioritize initiatives that support the growth, development, and happiness of our people.

To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have office spaces in Barcelona, Spain; Delhi, India; Galway, Ireland; London, England; New York, NY; and Washington, D.C.

Sobre a Área de Operações

O Time de Operações é o responsável por organizar o ecossistema e garantir que o cliente seja atendido sempre com excelência. E para fazer a conexão desta área com a necessidade do cliente, existem as equipes regionais que fazem a gestão dos pontos de vendas, e desenvolvem a melhor forma de aplicar o planejamento com a visão local.   • Realizar a gestão de despesas, custos e receitas
  • Garantir a manutenção das lojas

  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal, alta energia e resiliência
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial: segunda a sexta (09h às 18h) e sábado (08h às 13h).

We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to Know our Team

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world.   • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda’s new & emerging marketing channels
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 4-6 years of experience in Data Analyst position in tech, consulting, e-commerce or digital marketing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Data-Driven Approach: Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations.

  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

We Offer

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Key Responsibilities

Instructional Design

  • Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.
  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e-learning developers.
  • Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team culture.
  • Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple e-learning projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline, and budget.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e-learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross-functional teams and complex e-learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences.

NÓS SOMOS A AVIATOR. Uma empresa de pessoas para pessoas.

Fazer parte desse time é ter visão de dono, trabalhar em equipe e focado na busca por resultados ancorados em boas relações. Com Colaboradores e com o Cliente.

Foi no Rio de Janeiro, no mais carioca dos shoppings, o Rio Sul, que nasceu a primeira loja AVIATOR em 1987.

Com uma camisaria que impressionava por seu acabamento impecável, modelagem precisa e boa oferta de cores.

Ao longo dos anos a marca se estabeleceu como inquestionável destino para quem buscava clássicos do guarda roupa masculino, com preço convidativo e reconhecida qualidade. De lá pra cá, ampliamos a variedade de itens, tendo como fio condutor a atemporalidade de um produto bem feito e livre de modismos.

Hoje, temos da t-shirt ao blazer, do tênis ao tricot.

Hoje, a AVIATOR está presente em todo o Rio de Janeiro: do Leme ao Pontal, passando pelo Centro, Zonas Sul, Norte e Barra da Tijuca, dando uma esticadinha em Niterói.

Em Julho de 2024 abrimos a 1ª loja em SP no Pátio Paulista e Julho de 2025 abrimos a 2ª no Shopping Ibirapuera.

Em 2011 inauguramos a loja on-line, disponibilizando a marca para consumidores em todo o país. Desde então estamos expandindo nossa presença digital, que cresce em volume e resultado a cada ano.

Continuamos em expansão, crescendo de maneira planejada e cuidadosa sem abrir mão dos nossos valores.

Em Outubro de 2022 inauguramos nossa nova Sede em Botafogo, a Casa Aviator. Um ambiente que é a nossa cara, pensado e construído para ser o berço de nossas ideias e conquistas.

description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

A pessoa escolhida irá trabalhar no time de Apps, responsáveis pela manutenção e evolução dos aplicativos disponibilizados pela BigDataCorp no mercado. O foco será no BigID, uma avançada ferramenta de validação de identidade e prevenção à fraude. A atuação será no gerenciamento do desenvolvimento nas subcélulas de Documentoscopia, Biometria, KBA, Device Id e BackgroundCheck. O profissional será responsável por maximizar o valor gerado pelas aplicações, garantindo o alinhamento estratégico do desenvolvimento e a eficiência operacional da equipe em um cenário de crescente automação e complexidade tecnológica.

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida das funcionalidades, desde a tradução de requisitos em histórias de usuário até a priorização do backlog com base em um raciocínio estruturado e critérios de impacto, ROI e esforço;
  • Desenvolver e manter o roadmap estratégico das aplicações, identificando e planejando as iniciativas futuras que garantirão a evolução e a competitividade do produto;

  • Atuar como um mentor para a equipe, fomentando uma cultura de autonomia, segurança psicológica e melhoria contínua, e garantindo que o time compreenda o "porquê" estratégico por trás das tarefas que executam;
  • Definir e acompanhar os KPIs e métricas de sucesso para cada entrega, aplicando senso crítico para avaliar o desempenho das funcionalidades no nível operacional e validando hipóteses com testes A/B;
  • Consolidar os resultados e dados de produto para comunicar o valor gerado e o alinhamento com os OKRs da empresa, garantindo o engajamento e a visibilidade junto aos stakeholders e à diretoria;
  • Estabelecer e operar um sistema contínuo de coleta e análise de feedback, dados de uso e entrevistas com clientes para compreender profundamente o desempenho e a usabilidade do produto;
  • Utilizar os insights coletados para realizar análises de mercado, identificar tendências e descobrir novas oportunidades ou dores de clientes não atendidas, informando a estratégia de longo prazo.

Requirements

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência em gestão de produtos digitais (ex.: Product Manager, Product Owner etc.), idealmente em ambientes de tecnologia B2B;
  • Elevado senso crítico e raciocínio estruturado para decompor problemas complexos, questionar premissas e validar informações em um ambiente com crescente uso de automação e IA;
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas;

  • Inteligência emocional e maturidade para atuar como uma ponte eficaz entre negócio e tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de software (design patterns) e gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: Jira);
  • Perfil analítico e voltado a dados para fundamentar decisões estratégicas e de priorização;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos, de equipes técnicas a executivos, tanto internamente quanto com clientes externos.

O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos

  • Vivência no setor de dados, analytics ou em plataformas SaaS de alta complexidade;

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

As a Product Manager, you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media.

  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post‑launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.

  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction

  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well‑structured, data‑informed, written narrative
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Upper‑intermediate English level

NICE TO HAVES

  • Deep understanding of gaming trends
  • Strong background in app development and design

PERKS AND BENEFITS

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017 out of a conviction that iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different, Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist – a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug‑and‑play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem‑solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high‑performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest‑growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands‑on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data‑driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e‑commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in‑house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to life, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in‑house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set‑up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e‑commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e‑commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e‑commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast‑paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 2‑4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e‑commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside the box to create new best‑in‑class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, São Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are looking for a highly innovative, data-driven Email Marketing Manager, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest growing e-commerce and digital brands.

You will join a team of email, SMS and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, partner with internal cross functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross-functional team to build creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Spain, Mexico, Portugal, and Brazil.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e-commerce and digital marketing. You’re immersed in the world of direct-to-consumer growth marketing and love connecting strategy, creativity, and data to drive results.

  • 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands-on retention experience.

  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e-commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.

  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.

  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.

  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.

  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the primary retention lead for select clients, working to develop best-in-class retention strategies. On a bi-weekly basis, you will lead meetings with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.

  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.

  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email, SMS, loyalty and subscription programs.

  • Project manage and delegate campaign briefs to your team, consisting of both retention specialists and designers.

  • Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client to ensure campaign quality and accuracy.

  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.

  • Execute on automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

  • Coordinate cross-departmentally with the Growth, Digital, and Marketplaces teams to develop cohesive campaigns that drive client growth.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por dados e gostaria de aplicar seus conhecimentos para criar modelos de predição focados em performance de negócios, essa vaga é para você!

  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para entender problemas, levantar hipóteses e propor soluções baseadas em dados;

  • Monitorar a performance dos modelos em produção e propor melhorias contínuas;

  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com a evolução das práticas de ciência de dados na empresa.

  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL e Python;
  • Experiência em conduzir análises quantitativas robustas e consistentes, desde a definição do problema até a apresentação dos resultados;
  • Habilidade para criar e apresentar storytelling de dados, traduzindo insights técnicos em linguagem acessível para diferentes públicos;
  • Capacidade de definir problemas de negócio claros e propor soluções baseadas em dados que gerem impacto real;
  • Comportamento colaborativo, com comunicação objetiva e abertura para diferentes pontos de vista;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos que geraram valor ao negócio por meio de modelos preditivos ou análises estratégicas;
  • Escrita de código em nível de criação de protótipos, sem depender de engenheiros de software.

Desejável / Diferencial:

  • Conhecimentos em modelos de Machine Learning de reconhecimento de imagens (OCR, identificação de objetos, identificação de ambientes e etc);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência com criação e desenvolvimento de produtos.

Additional information

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on‑boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on‑boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on‑boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post‑sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on‑boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem‑solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world‑class on‑boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity

  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Company Overview


If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!


Role Summary


The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. The FST offers real‑time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment. The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites, providing world‑class service and creating lasting competitive advantage.


Responsibilities



  • Perform direct, in‑person service calls in response to customer requests.

  • Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly.

  • Work side‑by‑side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required.

  • Supervise the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly.

  • Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule.

  • Check equipment before commissioning and start‑up and evaluate performance during and after start‑up.

  • Monitor the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment.

title: Pessoa Técnica em Edificações | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura
description:
Pessoa Técnica em Edificações | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data‑driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Dentro da diretoria de Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura, a Fábrica de Cenários é a área responsável pela construção e entrega dos cenários que dão vida às produções de entretenimento, dramaturgia e eventos do Grupo Globo.

Reúne profissionais das mais diversas disciplinas — carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamentos e gestão técnica — que transformam projetos criativos em estruturas físicas com excelência técnica e artística.

Nosso desafio é equilibrar inovação, qualidade e velocidade de produção, em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em constante evolução, que integra arte, engenharia e tecnologia.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar tecnicamente a execução de obras e montagens cenográficas, garantindo o cumprimento dos projetos, cronogramas e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Realizar medições, levantamentos e controle de execução das etapas construtivas (carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamento, elétrica, etc.);
  • Realizar leitura de projetos, cortes e detalhamentos técnicos em projetos, assegurando a compatibilização entre os projetos de arquitetura, cenografia e infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar o time de orçamentos e suprimentos com informações técnicas e quantitativos de materiais;
  • Acompanhar fornecedores e prestadores de serviços durante as etapas de produção e montagem, garantindo conformidade técnica e segurança;
  • Contribuir para o controle de qualidade e atualização de padrões técnicos e construtivos da Fábrica;
  • Apoiar a implementação de boas práticas de Lean Construction e melhoria contínua nos processos produtivos.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação técnica completa em Edificações;
  • Experiência prévia em obras civis, cenográficas ou de estruturas temporárias;
  • Domínio com Projetos (leitura, interpretação e elaboração de plantas);
  • Conhecimento básico em medições, orçamentos e acompanhamento de obras;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Fábrica de Cenários e eventuais deslocamentos para estúdios e locações externas.
  • Conhecimento em Revit, SketchUp ou softwares 3D voltados à construção e cenografia;
  • Experiência em projetos de televisão, eventos, espetáculos ou produção de cenários;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Construction e metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de equipes multidisciplinares e integração de disciplinas;
  • Curso complementa­rio em Segurança do Trabalho ou Gestão de Projetos.

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link:

Sobre a Empresa

Somos a Rock World, uma empresa criadora de experiências que nasceu do maior festival de música e entretenimento do mundo, o Rock in Rio. Com a missão de proporcionar experiências inesquecíveis através da música e do entretenimento, temos como base da nossa cultura a arte de sonhar e do fazer acontecer. Queremos inspirar as pessoas para a construção de um mundo melhor.

Hoje, além do Rock in Rio Brasil e Rock in Rio Lisboa, expandimos nossa área de atuação para outros projetos de produção de experiências que abrangem diferentes áreas. No Live Entertainment, temos The Town e Lollapalooza Brasil em parceria com a C3. Na área de Conteúdo, temos os espetáculos originais, como o Uirapuru, o The Town O Musical, e o Amazônia Para Sempre. A Rock World se firma assim como uma das principais empresas globais de criação e produção de conteúdo proprietário de Live Experience.
